name: How long does a basement interior upgrade project usually take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a basement interior upgrade project usually take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a basement interior upgrade project depends on its complexity and size. A straightforward finishing project without major structural changes might take 4-8 weeks. Projects involving new plumbing, electrical work, or extensive layout modifications can extend to 10-16 weeks or longer. We provide a projected timeline in our proposal after assessing your specific project requirements.
acceptedAnswer.description: Project duration varies; basic finishing may take 4-8 weeks, while complex renovations with plumbing or electrical work can take 10-16 weeks or more.
